description: Reproducible code, configurations, de-identified prediction views, and audit outputs for a 22-endpoint, five-model, five-seed study of reliability after random-resplit validation-only ADMET model selection under scaffold shift. Source code is Apache-2.0; generated prediction views, metrics, tables, and original figures are CC BY 4.0; model checkpoints and raw TDC data are not released.
notes: Mixed licensing: see LICENSE and LICENSE-DATA.md. Raw TDC data, source structures and labels, and model checkpoints are excluded.
title: Trustworthy ADMET Benchmark: Reliability Regret after Single-Metric Random-Resplit Validation Selection
